# Enter KiCad Python here
import time

print("=== Layer Function Test Start ===")

print("1. Select F.Cu")
pcb_select_layer("F.Cu")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("2. Select B.Adhesive")
pcb_select_layer("B.Adhesive")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("3. Select Edge.Cuts")
pcb_select_layer("Edge.Cuts")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("4. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
state = pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", state)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("5. B.Adhesive OFF")
pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive", False)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("6. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive"))
time.sleep(0.5)

print("7. B.Adhesive ON")
pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive", True)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("8. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive"))
time.sleep(0.5)

print("=== Layer Function Test End ===")
